adopt:
# Only inside a checkout of this repository, or where the addon manifest has
# been installed to ~/.aither/components. From PyPI alone this raises
# "Unknown addon: aitherbrowser".
pip install awdk

# Start the browser here (port 8132) and
# register what it finds:
adk addon enable aitherbrowser

# Confirm it is serving. The image answers TLS when configured and plain
# HTTP on a bare node, so probe the one you actually started.
curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8132/health

# Status, and the container's own log when something is wrong:
adk addon status aitherbrowser
adk addon logs aitherbrowser
description:
Kind: pack

What it does
Run AitherBrowser on your own machine: an untethered Chromium an agent drives with the pilot_* tools — sessions, screenshots, extraction, taught recipes and saved logins that stay on your disk and never touch anyone else's hardware.

Runtime
awdk>=3.8.0

Tools
  pilot_open
  pilot_navigate
  pilot_observe
  pilot_parse_ui
  pilot_look
  pilot_click
  pilot_fill
  pilot_scroll
  pilot_extract
  pilot_save_login
  pilot_done
  pilot_close
